_meta.title: Menu Scaffold Registry — menu_type per subject×phase, DERIVED FROM THE HUMAN CORPUS.
_meta.what: menu_type tells the converter whether a page renders a #module-menu-content and, if so, tabbed vs simplified. Keyed by run.groupKey = subjectLetters|template_phase. 'overview'/'lesson' are the page scopes.
_meta.why: The Style-Anchor registry's menu_type was wrong for some groups (e.g. a lesson menu suppressed when the human has one). This file is measured directly from 01-Finalized_Modules_, so it is the Group-Majority truth. Re-run reference/tests/derive_menu_type.cjs after new modules ship.
_meta.cascade: ContentConverter.#menuTypeFor resolves: this group value (Group Majority) -> Style-Anchor menu_type -> global_default. A future per-series deviation can override its group here.
_meta.legacy: pre-round-147 rows (sub-page-diluted mining) — used only when MENUREG_OFF=1
